stories.title: 300 jobs expected as work begins on Port of Mostyn industrial site
stories.summary: Work has started on bringing a former industrial site at the Port of Mostyn back into use, as part of a £14.7 million upgrade backed by the North Wales Growth Deal. stories.title: Welsh Water emergency work leaves villages near Holywell with low or no water
stories.summary: Homes in villages south of Holywell may have no water or low water pressure this morning because of emergency work by Welsh Water. The area affected, shown on Welsh Water’s map, runs from Pantasaph and Brynford, alongside the A55, down through Pentre Halkyn, Halkyn and The Catch to Pen-y-parc near Rhosesmor. stories.title: Flintshire drug deaths stay at highest level in more than a decade as health board says trend is a concern
stories.summary: Seventeen drug poisoning deaths were registered in Flintshire last year, the same as in 2024 and up from five in 2022, official figures show. stories.title: Yellow fog warning for Flintshire from 6pm tonight until Tuesday morning
stories.summary: A yellow weather warning for fog is in place across Flintshire from 6pm today until 10am on Tuesday. The Met Office says fog will redevelop this evening, becoming dense at times overnight, with visibility reduced to less than 100 metres. It says this will likely lead to some delays to transport and difficult travelling conditions.
